title: Direct Procurement Method (DPM) Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) Recompete Personal Property Shipping, Drayage, and Warehousing Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > W6QK ACC- DTA
description:
The Direct Procurement Method (DPM) and the Army Contracting Command – Detroit Arsenal (ACC-DTA) are conducting a market survey to identify businesses capable of providing all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary to perform for the preparation of personal property of Department of War (DoW) personnel, military or civilian, for shipment and/or storage and related services through the DPM. The DPM Program was established to manage the shipment of domestic household goods, international-household goods, and unaccompanied baggage shipments using Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR)-based government contracts. 

 Please see the attachment for further details. Interested offerors are asked to complete the questionnaire within the attachment and provide answers back electronically to sydney.r.huston.civ@army.mil 

  
Please note: This is not a Request for Proposal (RFP) or Request for Quote (RFQ). This RFI is strictly for informational purposes for the Government. No award will be made from this RFI. We appreciate any information that is given in response to this RFI.
